action.description: A baneyspaces CLI command line (spec/cli.md), exec <command>, mode <name> or none.

chord.description: modifiers then one key, lowercase, joined with +: mod, cmd, super, win, ctrl, alt, shift; key names are in spec/keys.json under chords.keys. Needs a modifier in keys.bindings; the recovery chord (logo+shift+escape) is never bindable.

custom_theme.description: A custom theme: extends, tokens to change, and optionally a palette.

focused_role.description: for the current workspace, the selected row and the hovered tile

gradient.description: opacity at the top, then at the bottom

role.description: a palette role, or light, or workspace

extends.description: The built-in or custom theme this one starts from. Required.

material.description: The platform's blur, or "none" (null in JSON) for an opaque fill in tint_role.

family.description: A key into themes.json fonts (system-sans, monospace) or a font family name; the first installed family is used.

indicator.description: How a workspace shows in the dock, the bar module and the overview.

motion.description: The theme's own motion tokens. The animation section decides durations; scale_from and lift are the transforms.

list.description: the +N list and window strip panel

shadow.description: false (or null) for none, or {radius, y, opacity}. TOML has no null, so write false.

animation.description: Animations. Every transition runs on the compositor.

style.description: off (the default) switches instantly; fade and slide draw over a snapshot, windows never move

bangs.description: (Linux) your own launcher bangs, such as !jira PROJ-1.

agent.description: Ask an agent instead of opening a page.

trigger.description: The word after ! in the launcher.

url.description: An http(s) address with {q} where the words go.

auto_hide.description: (Linux) false keeps the dock up and reserves its space.

hide_ms.description: Wait before the dock goes down.

in_fullscreen.description: (Linux) come up over a full-screen window

reveal_ms.description: Wait before the dock comes up.

follow_focus.description: Switch to a window's workspace when you activate it yourself.

agent.description: (Linux) the bang trigger of the agent a leading ? asks

files.description: (Linux) search files and folders in your home folder

install.description: (Linux) offer to install and remove apps (omarchy pkg)

search_engine.description: (Linux) the bang trigger of the engine a plain search goes to

new_window.description: current | app (where the app's other windows are)

layout.description: adaptive gives workspaces with windows the room

hold_ms.description: how long a hold before it shows

hooks.description: Commands run as you on these events, logged. Shown in Settings.

on_switch.description: a command run as you after a workspace switch

on_window_open.description: a command run as you when a window opens

additionalProperties.description: A baneyspaces CLI command line, or exec <command>, mode <name>, or none.

bindings.description: Chord to action. "none" unbinds a default.

mod.description: The platform modifier. cmd, ctrl, alt on macOS; super on Linux; win, ctrl, alt on Windows.

app.description: An app name or bundle id.

title.description: A regular expression the window title must match.

workspace.description: Send the window to this workspace.

name.description: A built-in theme or a file in themes/.

override.description: Any token from themes.json, for this machine only.
